_about: Peak windows for directory cards (MM-DD/MM-DD, may wrap the new year; several windows allowed). A card in its window joins 'Worth checking now' on its directory with the note below. Keep notes short, factual and true every year. Apply with: python3 scripts/build-directory-peaks.py
